Digital Debut Announced

Following its theatrical release on October 2, 2026, the action-thriller 'Sigma' is confirmed for a digital premiere on Netflix on October 30, 2026. Directed by Jason Sanjay, son of actor Thalapathy Vijay, the film marks his debut in the director's chair.

Cast and Narrative

'Sigma' features Sundeep Kishan as the lead, portraying a man who orchestrates a heist against a gambling syndicate to overcome financial hardship. Faria Abdullah co-stars alongside a supporting cast including Yogi Babu and Sampath Raj. The project features a musical score by Thaman S.

Reception and Access

Despite significant pre-release anticipation, the film faced mixed critical reception and modest theatrical returns. The upcoming OTT launch in Tamil and Telugu aims to reach a broader audience.
